biography: I started as a mobile developer and spent a few years as a senior engineer shipping Flutter and native apps for enterprise clients. That work taught me to care about what happens after release: monitoring, debugging, and fixing things quickly when they break.

In 2025 I moved into AI as an AI & ML Engineer at TCS Hungary. I build RAG systems over ServiceNow knowledge, agent workflows connected to SAP SuccessFactors and ServiceNow, a candidate ranking platform, and a workforce scheduling optimizer. Most of the effort goes into retrieval quality, permissions, and integrations rather than the model itself.
I'm also doing an MSc in Computer Science with an AI specialization at ELTE in Budapest. There I co-authored a paper on Social Attraction PSO, a swarm optimization method, published at ICCCI 2026.
